title: Fix UBSAN: Pass NULL as source to memcpy
description:
It's not allowed to pass `NULL` as a source to `memcpy()`. This was done twice in `getcpuperf()`, [see this issue](https://github.com/bobjansen/rscrypt/issues/1).

These commits fix the issue by creating a salt of all `0` and bumps the version to 0.1.4.

To keep the package on CRAN action should be taken before 25 April. If I receive no comments, I plan to submit to CRAN on the 16th.

title: remove redundant usages of Rcpp APIs
description:
- `Rcpp:::CxxFlags()` is not required here, as this work is effectively accomplished by using `LinkingTo: Rcpp` in the DESCRIPTION file.
- Similarly, `Rcpp:::LdFlags()` is a no-op nowadays.

title: Add configure.ac and run autoreconf -fvi && autoconf && ./configure
description:
Prof. Brian Ripley pointed out that the configure.ac file was missing
but is required by CRAN policies. I've obtained the configure.ac,
acscrypt.m4 and Makefile.am files from the the tarsnap/scrypt repo,
files as of commitish b14cf18d.

Work started to get rscrypt back on CRAN, see #13.

title: Fix clock getres
description:
Per email with Brian Ripley, the type on clock_getres was incorrect according to POSIX standard: 
http://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/clock_gettime.html

This is causing build failures on MacOSX 10.12

title: Fix namespace collision with OpenSSL
description: This causes a crash when running R within RStudio Server.
